mappings.name: Sending Facility
mappings.notes: Often maps to an Organization reference in clinical context

mappings.name: Message Type
mappings.notes: Mapped using Message Type ValueSet (e.g. ADT^A08 -> ADT-A08)

mappings.name: Patient Identifier List
mappings.notes: Maps PID-3.1 (ID) to identifier.value, and PID-3.4 (Assigning Authority) to identifier.system OID

mappings.name: Patient Name
mappings.notes: Maps PID-5.1 (Family Name) to name.family, and PID-5.2 (Given Name) to name.given

mappings.name: Administrative Sex
mappings.notes: Mapped: M -> male, F -> female, O -> other, U -> unknown

mappings.name: Patient Address
mappings.notes: Maps PID-11.1 to address.line, PID-11.3 to address.city, PID-11.4 to address.state, PID-11.5 to address.postalCode

mappings.name: Patient Class
mappings.notes: Mapped: I -> inpatient, O -> outpatient, E -> emergency, R -> ambulatory

mappings.name: Visit Number
mappings.notes: Often maps to an encounter or billing account identifier

mappings.name: Value Type
mappings.notes: Determines value type: NM -> valueQuantity, ST/TX -> valueString, CE/CWE -> valueCodeableConcept

mappings.name: Observation Identifier
mappings.notes: Maps OBX-3.1 to code.coding.code, OBX-3.2 to code.coding.display, OBX-3.3 to code.coding.system (e.g. LN for LOINC)

mappings.name: Observation Value
mappings.notes: Value is formatted based on OBX-2

mappings.name: Units
mappings.notes: Maps OBX-6.1 to valueQuantity.unit and valueQuantity.code, OBX-6.3 to valueQuantity.system (UCUM)

mappings.name: Observation Result Status
mappings.notes: Mapped: F -> final, C -> corrected, P -> preliminary, X -> cancelled
